description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
